description: check-then-act across an await: concurrent callers for the same key all miss the cache and all run the loader. The inflight map exists but is never used.

bugs.hint: cache.has() is checked before an await; N concurrent callers with the same key each invoke load(), defeating the cache and duplicating side effects.

traps.why: invalidate() deleting a key is correct in a single-threaded event loop.
